author: dev.yadhakim
name: comparison-block
description: A morphing side-by-side comparison component with expandable panels, SVG score rings, tug-of-war attribute bars, and an animated verdict summary. Click either panel to expand it while the other recedes. Built with Lora + Figtree. Fully responsive, dark mode compatible, and content-agnostic — compare frameworks, tools, approaches, or anything else.
